vulnerability.impact: JNDI lookup substitution in log messages enabling remote code execution

entry_points: MessagePatternConverter.format(LogEvent, StringBuilder) - line ~132: workingBuilder.append(config.getStrSubstitutor().replace(event, value)) performs  lookup substitution in log messages
JndiLookup.lookup(String) - resolves jndi: URLs through JndiManager
JndiManager.lookup(String) - JNDI lookup used by the vulnerable path
ground_truth.fix_commit: Released in rel/2.15.0. Fix set: 001aaada7dab82c3c09cde5f8e14245dc9d8b454 (LOG4J2-3198: lookups no longer formatted in messages by default; changes MessagePatternConverter + Constants) and c77b3cb39312b83b053d23a2158b99ac7de44dd3 (restrict LDAP access via JNDI; changes JndiManager/NetUtils/JmsAppender). Pinned snapshot be881e503e14b267fb8a8f94b6d15eddba7ed8c4 equals the rel/2.14.1 tag commit.
ground_truth.affected_range: Apache Log4j 2.0-beta9 through 2.14.1 (2.15.0 fixes the default message-lookup and LDAP paths); Java versions 8u121+ / 7u201+ / 6u211+ are exploitable for the LDAP remote-class-loading route.
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report identifies the  lookup path from log messages to JNDI (MessagePatternConverter -> StrSubstitutor -> JndiLookup/JndiManager) in the pinned 2.14.1 code, names CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell), and attributes RCE/JNDI injection. A finding only about  or JNDI with no message-pattern reachability is not TP. FP: flags 2.15.0+ behavior or unrelated JMS appender code.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: MessagePatternConverter.format calls StrSubstitutor.replace on event message text and JndiLookup/JndiManager are enabled by default in the snapshot; 001aaada disables the substitution path and c77b3cb restricts JNDI. Dynamic check only against an isolated log4j app whose log directory/file is a disposable temp path, with no outbound LDAP or network sink; use benign payloads (e.g.  or local test LDAP).
